findings.code_snippet:
## Is it in scope

The policy says: if you are unsure whether an issue is a security vulnerability, report it anyway; the Security Team decides. Say which role triggers the finding (anonymous visitor, frontend user, backend user, administrator). Do not judge scope from the lists on the discontinued bug bounty page.

Look for an existing advisory first: `https://packagist.org/api/security-advisories/?packages%5B%5D=<vendor/package>` and the TYPO3-EXT-SA list. Compare the advisory's affected range with the version you hold. An advisory for another defect in the same extension does not cover yours.
